author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸೆಗಳಿರಬಹುದು ಅನುಮಾನವಿರಬಹುದು
ಸುಜ್ಞಾನಿಯ ಜೊತೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಉತ್ತರವ ಹುಡುಕು
ಅಜ್ಞನಾಗದೆ ನೀನು ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ
ತಜ್ಞನಾಗೆಲೊ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There may be questions, there may be doubts;
sit with a wise person and look for the answers;
don’t stay ignorant: gather what can be known,
and become an expert yourself, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Doubts are natural. Take them to people who know, keep gathering knowledge instead of staying ignorant, and in time you will become knowledgeable yourself.
